title: Composition with security-auth-magic-link gates the magic-link mint surface behind the Turnstile guard
asA: shelf consumer applying both security-auth-magic-link and edge-cloudflare-turnstile
iWant: the magic-link mint surface to be registered under the Turnstile guard so a mint submit reads through the same token check as any other elicited surface, and a mint without a valid Turnstile token to be refused with 400 before the mint fires
soThat: magic-link mint requests are protected by the same human-check as any other public form

acceptanceCriteria.description: The pack fixture ships a /api/magic-link mint stub route registered under the Turnstile guard. A source-tree read of the composition wire confirms the mint surface reads the Turnstile guard before invoking the magic-link mint.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture with both blueprints applied and /api/magic-link registered under the token-required guard
acceptanceCriteria.when: the composition wire is walked in the source tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the magic-link mint surface reads the Turnstile guard before invoking the mint

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to /api/magic-link without a Cf-Turnstile-Response field, and a POST carrying the always-fail response token that fails siteverify, are both refused with 400 by the Turnstile guard and no magic-link mint side-effect is observable. The Playwright pack check magicLinkGuard drives this against the fixture with a real browser.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with both blueprints applied and a real Playwright browser driving the fixture
acceptanceCriteria.when: a magic-link mint submit is issued without a Turnstile response, or with the always-fail response token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Turnstile guard refuses with 400 and no magic-link mint side-effect is observable
